description: Difficult eBay sold listings for evaluating the semantic fallback classifier. Labels are hand-assigned by reviewing each title against TCGdex card data - never model-generated.

labels.TARGET: Title identifies the exact target card.
labels.NOT_TARGET: Title identifies a different card or a non-card product.
labels.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Title genuinely cannot settle which card was sold.
